enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed on back. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn onto right side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Adjust the pillow with the left hand. Turn onto left side. Extend legs. Keep lying in bed. Remain lying without getting up.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth (using the bathroom before Member 2's 07:30 slot)
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Put both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the light switch. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Bend forward. Splash water onto the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothpaste. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Put the toothpaste down. Lift the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush. Place the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom. Pull the door closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone messages quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Place it on the bed. Take out trousers. Place them on the bed. Take off the sleepwear top. Pull the shirt over the arms. Button up the shirt. Take off the sleepwear bottoms. Pull on the trousers. Zip up. Close the wardrobe door. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the side button to light the screen. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the messages icon. Scroll down the message list. Tap one message. Read it. Type a short reply. Press send. Tap back. Scroll through two more messages. Place the phone face down on the nightstand. Stand up. Pick up a pair of socks. Pull the socks on. Put on shoes. Tie the laces.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with Member 2 (coffee for me, toast and kettle-boiled tea for Member 2)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Take out the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on the counter. Open the bag. Take out two slices. Place the slices in the toaster. Press the lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the counter. Take out the coffee jar. Unscrew the lid. Spoon one spoonful of coffee into the mug. Close the lid. Place the coffee jar back. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch down. Wait for the kettle to boil. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Stir with a spoon. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on two plates. Open the refrigerator. Take out the butter. Spread butter on the toast with a knife. Close the refrigerator. Hand one plate to Member 2. Say "Breakfast is ready." Sit down at the table. Pick up the mug. Drink coffee. Pick up the toast. Bite. Chew. Put the toast down. Drink coffee again. Talk with Member 2 about the day's plan. Finish the toast. Finish the coffee. Stand up. Pick up the plate and mug. Carry them to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Place it on the floor. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Push the power button. Push the vacuum forward across the floor. Pull it back. Walk forward step by step. Vacuum around the sofa. Lift the sofa cushions. Vacuum under the cushions. Put the cushions back. Move the coffee table to one side with both hands. Vacuum under the table. Push the table back. Vacuum the corner near the TV stand. Press the power button to stop. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wind the cord around the hook. Carry the vacuum back to the corner. Pick up magazines from the coffee table. Stack them. Place them on the shelf. Pick up two empty cups. Carry them to the kitchen counter. Come back. Straighten the cushions on the sofa. Fold the blanket lying on the sofa. Place the folded blanket on the armrest. Say to Member 2 "The floor is done."

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone messages and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the screen to wake it. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the messages icon. Scroll through the message list. Open one conversation. Type a reply. Press send. Open a second conversation. Read it. Type a reply. Press send. Put the phone down on the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Place both hands on the keyboard. Click the browser icon. Type a search term. Press enter. Scroll down the results page. Click one link. Read the page. Scroll down. Click back. Open a second tab. Type in the address bar. Press enter. Scroll through the page. Click a video. Watch it. Close the tab. Scroll the news page. Move the mouse. Click a link. Read the article. Close the browser window. Press the power button. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Push the chair back under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market and buying a takeaway coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the front door. Take the tote bag off the hook. Put on a jacket. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the pocket. Walk down the stairs. Walk along the street to the market. Enter the market. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk to the vegetable stall. Pick up two tomatoes. Put them into the basket. Pick up a cucumber. Put it in the basket. Pick up a bag of greens. Place it in the basket. Walk to the fruit stall. Pick up three apples. Place them in the basket. Walk to the weighing counter. Place the basket on the scale. Wait. Pick up the items. Place them into the tote bag. Take out the phone. Open the payment app. Show the QR code to the vendor. Press confirm to pay. Put the phone back into the pocket. Walk to the coffee shop. Stand in line. Step up to the counter. Say "One takeaway latte, please." Take out the phone. Pay with the QR code. Step aside. Wait. Pick up the paper cup from the counter. Walk out of the shop. Walk back along the street. Drink the coffee while walking.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the cafe. Push the door open. Step inside. Walk to an empty table. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Put the tote bag on the floor beside the chair. Pick up the menu from the table. Open it. Read the pages. Turn the page. Close the menu. Put it back on the table. Raise the hand to call the waiter. Say "I'll have the set lunch." Wait. Pick up the glass of water. Drink. Place the glass down. The plate is placed on the table. Pick up the fork. Cut the food. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew. Pick up the knife. Cut again. Continue eating. Drink water. Finish the food. Put the fork and knife down on the plate. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Pick up the phone. Open the payment app. Pay the bill. Put the phone away. Stand up. Push the chair back in. Pick up the tote bag. Walk to the door. Push it open. Step out.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking through the park and enjoying the public holiday outdoors
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the street to the park entrance. Step onto the path. Walk slowly along the path. Pass a bench. Continue walking. Walk past the flower beds. Stop at the pond. Stand and look at the pond. Take the phone out of the pocket. Hold it up. Take a photo of the pond. Lower the phone. Put it back in the pocket. Continue walking along the path. Walk up a small slope. Reach the top of the slope. Walk down the other side. Pass a group of people sitting on the grass. Walk along the tree-lined path. Stop at a bench. Sit down on the bench. Put the tote bag beside the leg. Sit for several minutes. Stand up. Pick up the tote bag. Walk back along the path. Exit the park at the side gate. Walk along the street back toward home.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light afternoon snack and putting away groceries
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Place the tote bag on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take the vegetables out of the tote bag. Place the greens in the drawer. Place the tomatoes on the shelf. Place the apples in the fruit tray. Take the milk out of the tote bag. Place it on the door shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard. Place the dry goods on the shelf. Close the cupboard. Pick up the tote bag. Fold it. Hang it on the hook. Take a yogurt cup out of the refrigerator. Peel the lid off. Pick up a spoon from the drawer. Spoon the yogurt. Eat it. Place the empty cup in the sink. Rinse the cup under the tap. Place the cup in the dishwasher. Open the dishwasher door. Close it.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the screen. Place the remote on the cushion beside the leg. Lean back against the sofa. Cross the legs. Watch the program. Pick up the remote again. Change the channel. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Get up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass with water. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Place the glass on the coffee table. Drink water. Pick up the remote. Change the channel again. Watch. Shift position. Lean back. Put the feet up on the ottoman. Watch the program. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Put the remote back on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone while Member 2 finishes freelance work
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the book from the coffee table. Open it at the bookmark. Hold the book with both hands. Read the page. Turn the page. Continue reading. Close the book. Place it on the lap. Pick up the phone from the cushion. Press the screen to wake it. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the news app. Scroll down the feed. Tap one article. Read it. Scroll down. Tap back. Open the social media app. Scroll through the feed. Tap the like button on a post. Scroll further. Tap a photo. Close the photo. Scroll down again. Tap the comment box. Type a short comment. Press send. Close the app. Place the phone face down on the coffee table. Pick up the book again. Open it. Turn the page. Continue reading. Look toward Bedroom 2 door. Say to Member 2 "Take your time." Continue reading. Close the book. Place it on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 2 using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the chicken. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the drawer. Take out the cutting board. Place it on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife. Rinse the vegetables under the tap. Place them on the board. Cut the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Slide the pieces into a bowl. Turn on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Wait for the oil to heat. Add the vegetables to the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add salt from the shaker. Stir again. Press the oven button. Open the oven door. Place the tray inside. Close the oven door. Set the timer. Say to Member 2 "Can you pass me the plate?" Take the plate from Member 2. Spoon the vegetables onto the plate. Press the power button to turn off the induction cooker.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 2 and washing up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up two plates. Carry them to the table. Place them on the table. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Lift food to the mouth. Chew. Put the fork down. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Pick up the fork again. Continue eating. Take a second helping from the serving bowl with the spoon. Place it on the plate. Eat. Finish the food. Put the fork down on the plate. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Stand up. Pick up the plates and glasses. Carry them to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plates. Place them in the dishwasher. Open the dishwasher door. Load the plates. Load the glasses. Add the detergent tablet. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table. Rinse the cloth. Hang it on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa beside Member 2. Pick up the remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Browse the program list. Press the select button. Place the remote on the coffee table. Lean back. Watch the screen. Talk with Member 2 about the program. Pick up the glass of water. Drink. Place the glass down. Pick up the remote. Turn up the volume. Put the remote down. Shift position on the sofa. Pull the blanket over the legs. Watch. Pick up the remote. Change the channel. Watch the next program. Laugh and say something to Member 2. Continue watching. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Put the remote back on the coffee table. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the light switch. Turn on the water heater switch. Pull the shower curtain aside. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Hang the clothes on the hook. Take off the socks. Step into the shower area. Turn on the tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Wet the body. Press the shampoo bottle. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Press the body wash bottle. Rub the body wash over the arms and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rail. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the body. Walk to the sink. Wipe the mirror with the hand. Open the cabinet. Take out the toner bottle. Pour toner onto a cotton pad. Wipe the face with the pad. Take out the moisturizer jar. Open the lid. Apply cream to the face with the fingers. Close the lid. Place the jar back. Close the cabinet. Take the clothes. Put on the sleepwear. Hang the towel on the rail. Turn off the light switch. Turn off the water heater switch. Open the door. Step out. Pull the door closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down quietly and sleeping in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket back. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the screen to wake it. Swipe up to unlock. Open the messages app. Scroll through the list. Tap one conversation. Type a reply. Press send. Close the app. Open the video app. Scroll through the feed. Watch one video. Close the app. Plug the charger cable into the phone. Place the phone on the nightstand. Stand up. Walk to the light switch. Turn off the main light. Walk back to the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow with both hands. Turn onto the right side. Close the eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain lying. Sleep.
